description: End-of-invocation write-back. Applies the per-destination update policy from `.ai/agents/context.md#update-protocol`: state (snapshot or replace-with-archive), knowledge (append-only), logs (append-only). Always emits an audit entry. Refuses writes to destinations not declared in the agent's Context Manifest.
checklist: 1. Verify every destination the agent intends to write to is declared in its Context Manifest `State` or `Outputs` section. Reject writes to undeclared paths — that is a manifest violation

2. For `.ai/agents/state/<agent>/` writes with policy='replace-with-archive': archive the previous file to `.archive/.ai/agents/state/<agent>/<filename>.<timestamp>.json` per `.ai/maintenance.md#archive-patterns` BEFORE writing the new snapshot

3. For `.ai/agents/state/<agent>/` writes with policy='snapshot' (append-and-rotate): append a new entry; if the file exceeds the agent's declared max size, rotate older entries to `.archive/.ai/agents/state/<agent>/`
4. For `.ai/knowledge/` writes: append-only. Search for an existing entry with the same `id` or `title`+`scope` first; refine in place if found; never rewrite historical entries
5. For `.ai/logs/` writes: append-only audit entries; never rewrite or truncate. One entry per significant agent action; include `trace_id` from the envelope
6. Scrub any candidate write for secrets, tokens, credentials, or `.env` content per `.ai/credentials.md`. Refuse the write if found
7. Bump `schema_version` and archive on schema changes — never silent migrations
8. Emit a final audit-log entry summarizing what was written: { trace_id, agent, destinations[], counts }
